cases.sentence: К Иисусу подошли ___ и стали с ним спорить.
cases.translation: The Pharisees came to Jesus and began to argue with him.
cases.explain: Фарисеи is the subject of подошли (came up) → nominative plural.

cases.sentence: Ученики забыли взять с собой ___, и в лодке у них был всего один хлеб.
cases.translation: The disciples forgot to take bread, and they had only one loaf in the boat.
cases.explain: After взять (to take) in this partitive sense ('some bread'), the noun takes the genitive → хлеба.

cases.sentence: По ___ Иисус спросил их, «За кого принимают меня люди?»
cases.translation: On the way, Jesus asked them, 'Who do people say I am?'
cases.explain: The preposition по (along) governs the dative → дороге.

cases.sentence: Иисус взял ___ за руку, вывел его из селения...
cases.translation: Jesus took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village...
cases.explain: Слепой is the direct object of взял (took); being animate, its accusative equals the genitive → слепого.

cases.sentence: Иисус отпустил народ и сразу же, сев вместе с ___ в лодку, отправился в земли Далмануты.
cases.translation: Jesus dismissed the crowd and immediately, getting into the boat with his disciples, went to the region of Dalmanutha.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → учениками.

cases.sentence: Как же здесь, в этой ___, найти достаточно хлеба, чтобы их накормить?
cases.translation: How can anyone find enough bread here in this desert to feed them?
cases.explain: В marking location (no motion) takes the prepositional → пустыне.

reading.ru: Мне жаль этих людей, они со мной вот уже три дня, и у них не осталось еды.
reading.question: Why did Jesus feel compassion for the crowd before feeding the 4,000?
options: They had been with him three days and had no food left
They were being persecuted by soldiers
reading.correct: They had been with him three days and had no food left
reading.explain: Jesus said he felt compassion because the people had been with him three days and had nothing left to eat.

reading.ru: Говорю вам истину, ему не будет дано никакого знамения.
reading.question: How did Jesus respond to the Pharisees' demand for a sign from heaven?
options: He said no sign would be given to that generation
He performed an even greater miracle
He agreed to show them a sign the next day
reading.correct: He said no sign would be given to that generation
reading.explain: Jesus said, 'Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.'

reading.question: What warning did Jesus give his disciples in the boat?
options: To beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod
To beware of storms on the lake
To beware of false prophets from Rome
To beware of eating too much bread
reading.correct: To beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod
reading.explain: Jesus warned them, 'Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.'

reading.question: How many baskets of leftovers did the disciples collect after the feeding of the 5,000?
reading.explain: When asked how many baskets were collected after feeding the five thousand, the disciples answered, 'Twelve.'

reading.ru: Тот посмотрел вокруг и сказал, вижу людей, словно двигаются деревья.
reading.question: What did the blind man at Bethsaida see after Jesus' first touch?
options: People that looked like trees walking
reading.correct: People that looked like trees walking
reading.explain: After the first touch, the man said he saw people, but they looked like trees walking.

reading.ru: Иисус еще раз приложил руки к его глазам, и он исцелился, зрение вернулось к нему, и он стал видеть все четко и ясно.
reading.question: What happened after Jesus touched the blind man's eyes a second time?
options: His sight was fully restored and he saw everything clearly
He saw only shapes, not colors
reading.correct: His sight was fully restored and he saw everything clearly
reading.explain: After Jesus touched his eyes again, his sight was restored and he saw everything clearly.

reading.question: How did Peter answer when Jesus asked, "Who do you say I am?"

reading.ru: Иисус же, обернувшись и посмотрев на учеников, строго сказал Петру, «Прочь от меня, сатана! Ты рассуждаешь по-человечески и не понимаешь того, что хочет Бог».
reading.question: How did Jesus respond when Peter rebuked him for predicting his death?
options: He rebuked Peter, calling him "Satan" for thinking in human terms
He agreed with Peter and changed his plan
reading.correct: He rebuked Peter, calling him "Satan" for thinking in human terms
reading.explain: Jesus rebuked Peter, saying, 'Get behind me, Satan! You do not have in mind the things of God.'

reading.ru: Если кто желает быть моим последователем, пусть отречется от самого себя, возьмет свой крест и пусть следует за мной.
reading.question: What did Jesus say was required to be his follower?
options: Deny oneself, take up one's cross, and follow him
reading.correct: Deny oneself, take up one's cross, and follow him
reading.explain: Jesus said whoever wants to be his follower must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow him.
